description:
Use this when the user wants to pick a YouTube playlist for a post: "which playlists do I have", "add this
        Short to my Highlights playlist", "show my channel's playlists". account_id: from list_social_accounts; empty
        works when one YouTube channel is connected. Returns each playlist's playlist_id, title and video count (the
        first 50) and whether RipClip may add videos to them.
        Not for: putting the video in a playlist (update_draft with playlist_id or new_playlist on a draft) or the
        channel's other numbers (get_account_stats). Free and read only; it reads the channel from YouTube.
name: list_youtube_playlists
title: List YouTube playlists
